text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime, I spot Голд Сити and Oguri
Cap in
the cafeteria. On their table they
have lined up a
ton of bags packed with
fancy sweets.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you... What was it again you
promised?
Farm equipment?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
What? No! Gifts I got from a modeling
gig. You
told me you'd take extras if I
couldn't eat them
all.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I couldn't imagine not being
able to
finish eating something, so I
forgot about it.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
I made sure to keep the ones I got from
my fans
separate, so you're welcome to
eat all of them.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're not going to have any? You
know,
Tama says eating with someone
else is the best
seasoning.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... I gotta watch my calories.
Really
tempting offer, though.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Trainer, were you listening? Can
you
explain to her why I can't eat any?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Moderation is the key to winning!
Calories are the key to winning!

text_block_list.text:
Right? Not like that's news to anyone
here.
Although... they did mix in a few
treats from my
favorite store...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Wait, I am?! T-true, I do have training
after this,
so one bite can't hurt, can it?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You're not serious! B-but, you're right
about
needing the energy to perform
well.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Hnnghh... Okay, just for today! Oguri, I
highly
recommend that chocolate
terrine.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Terrine... I thought it was a cake. Then
what's in
this tin over here?
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
And so, Голд Сити enjoys just a tiny bit
of the
tasty sweets.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Opening one bag after another, Gold
City enjoys
as many sweets as she can
manage with Oguri
Cap.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
